# dsh-geo-seo

> GEO/SEO health check for DSH plugin repositories: score docs against a versioned rule pack, then generate llms.txt, ai.txt and JSON-LD from the same verified facts.

- Version: 0.1.0
- License: MIT
- Repository: git+https://github.com/garcey6/dsh-geo-seo.git
- Homepage: https://github.com/garcey6/dsh-geo-seo#readme
- Last updated: 2026-11-24
